title: chard error envelope
description: What stdout carries in place of a command's document when chard exits 2 (it refused the invocation or failed, a command line clap refuses among them, and a declared `--execution` that what chard observed contradicts) or 3 (`measure` built a report that contradicts itself and did not publish it). `src/error.rs` states the classification, and `tests/schema_conformance.rs` (`every_envelope_conforms_to_the_error_schema`) holds live envelopes to this file.

chard_schema.description: The major version of this document's shape. When it moves is the CLI contract's rule (`chard --help`; DESIGN.md, "The command-line contract"): a key chard adds is not a change, which is why every object here admits one.

code.description: Whose action comes next: `USER_INPUT` the caller, `PERMISSION` whoever owns the filesystem, `TRANSIENT` a retry, `CONFIGURATION` the invocation's settings, `INTERNAL` a bug report against chard. On exit 3 it is always `INTERNAL`.

operation.description: The command that refused or failed, or `chard` where a command line names none.

message.description: What failed, the context chain joined by `: `.

hint.description: What to do next, where chard can say; on exit 3, where the report it refused to publish is kept, or how to keep it.
